visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: The || Default Instead of if / else
visualizerParams.problemDescription: An if / else with hasOwnProperty decides between starting at 1 and adding 1. Use the || 0 default. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A missing key reads as undefined, and undefined || 0 is 0, so one expression covers both the first and the later occurrences.
